title: Asset overview
description: Current inventory and completed transactions in the selected period.
exportError: Unable to export the Excel report.
seatsHint: Seat activity uses frozen snapshots only. Unavailable means the historical source or disposal seat definition is insufficient; current capacity is never substituted.
periodHint: Completed from {{from}} through {{to}}, using the actual completion timestamp (same time basis as Reports).
recentHint: Selected period, ordered by actual completion. Open a code for voucher details.
statusHint: Asset status is separate from physical condition. Damaged and in repair are not combined.
currentHint: Live totals, independent of the period filter. Devices, components and license packages are counted separately.
chartHint: All four series count vouchers, not assets. Days without activity are omitted.
actionsHint: Current queues, independent of the period. Email failures count latest attempts per recipient/event; PDF failures exclude later successful publication.
damagedCondition: Devices in damaged physical condition (may overlap statuses)
